Name: Depths Display
Author: semitart
Description:
[b]See the whole floor without running every tile.[/b]

Depths Display adds a small panel that lists what is on your current underground level: nodes, objects, ladders, shafts, and living monsters, with icons and counts that update as you play. Install it and go. No setup and no cheat mechanics!

Works in the Mines, Skull Cavern, Volcano Dungeon, Quarry, Sewers, and most modded caves. It stays hidden on the farm, in town, and in mine entrances.
[line]
[size=4][b]HUD Elements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Resources:[/b] Ores, gems, geodes, stones, boulders, barrels, crates, forage, ice crystals, and more[/*]
[*][b]Exits:[/b] Ladders and shafts, including multiple per floor[/*]
[*][b]Monsters:[/b] Shows all currently alive monsters, with a marker (!) for dangerous variants[/*]
[*][b]Layout:[/b] Three tidy sections, alphabetical order, optional icons, semi-transparent background[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4][b]Options[/b][/size]

Toggle the HUD with [b]H[/b] (default). Pick a screen corner, adjust size and margins, or turn icons off. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] supported.
Toggle the filter menu with [b]R[/b] (default). Pick what shows up in the HUD with a user-friendly GUI. Save and load filters.
[line]
[size=4][b]Requirements & install[/b][/size]

Needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and Stardew Valley 1.6+. Unzip to [i]Mods[/i], launch through SMAPI, head underground!
[line]
[b]Author:[/b] semitart

Feedback welcome, especially screenshots if something looks wrong in your game!
[line]
[i]Thank you for downloading Depths Display. Happy mining![/i]
